title: Questions Before Hiring a Planner
summary: Crucial questions to ask your prospective event planner to ensure the right alignment.
lead_paragraph: Before choosing an event partner, inquire about their coordination style, backup plans, vendor relationships, and on-site team size to ensure a perfect match for your celebration.
